_comment: Weapon and spell table for Fortune's Weave: 101 entries from the Fire Emblem Wiki list, grouped into 9 weapon types ({"Sword":21,"Spear":23,"Axe":19,"Bow":12,"Gauntlets":7,"Black magic":7,"Dark magic":2,"White magic":5,"?":5}) and 1 list sections ({"Unclassified":101}).

_columns.level: The weapon level a unit needs to equip it, using the same letter grades as the class system.
_columns.weight: Contributes to whether a unit can follow up; heavier weapons slow the wielder down.
_columns.curse: A stat specific to this game, filled in by cursed weapons rather than ordinary ones.
_columns.range: Attack range, so 1 is melee and 2 is a thrown or ranged weapon.
_columns.uses: Durability, meaning how many times it can be used before it breaks.
